tenderSchedule.description: ANNUAL MAINTENANCE CONTRACT(AMC) FOR REPAIRS,SERVICING AND MAINTENANCE OF SWM VEHICLES(LIGHT VEHICLES) OWENED BY KALABURGI MAHANAGAR PALIKE

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: An undertaking/ Declaration that the firm has their workshop within a radius of 10 Kms from Kalaburagi Mahanagara Palike head office.

An undertaking/ Self- Declaration that the firm has not been blacklisted by any Government Department /Government undertaking / any other agency and no criminal case has initiated/ registered against the agency/firm or its owner/proprietor/partner anywhere in India.

Annual Turnover of amount equivalent to Rs. 79.31 Lakhs for atleast in any 1 years during last 5 financial years 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26 Certified by Chartered Accountant along with UDIN no.

The bidder shall submit the documents / Details of past experience for providing the maintenance / repair services of vehicles from atleast One Government Organisations/ Institutes of not less than Rs. 39.65 Lakhs during any of last 5 years i.e 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26 Completion certificate issued by Executive engineer or Equivalent competent Authority
Trade License - Renewed for Present Year.
